description_en: Resumes traffic on an instance from Classic Load Balancer (CLB), Network Load Balancer (NLB), CLB gateway routing, Application Load Balancer (ALB) gateway routing, and Kubernetes Service
description_zh: 将实例上来自 CLB 应用访问、NLB 应用访问、CLB 网关路由、ALB 网关路由、K8S Service 上的流量恢复
name: ResumeTraffic

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. To specify multiple instances, separate their IDs with commas

4xx: A client-side error occurred.
